description: Shares one image (PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP, AVIF; not SVG) or PDF as a new site with a viewer and a Download button: without content, returns a link where the user drops their file; with name and content (base64, up to 10 MB; resize and compress photos first) it is published at once.

name.description: With content: file name with extension, e.g. menu.pdf
